single_task_average.estimand: Equal arithmetic mean of the seven endpoint MAE percentage changes, excluding the triad row.
single_task_average.denominator: For each endpoint, 100 × mean across paired seeds of (single-task MAE − comparator MAE) / mean comparator MAE across those seeds. Recompute numerator and denominator within every draw.
single_task_average.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of paired group-draw means, conditional on fitted models.

range_checks: All displayed estimates and intervals fit their axes. E retains the original displayed x-range.
